javascript.goToProjectConfig.title: Go to Project Configuration (jsconfig / tsconfig)
typescript.goToProjectConfig.title: Go to Project Configuration (tsconfig)
configuration.referencesCodeLens.enabled: Enable/disable references CodeLens in JavaScript and TypeScript files. This CodeLens shows the number of references for classes and exported functions and allows you to peek or navigate to them.
configuration.referencesCodeLens.showOnA: Enable/disable the [references CodeLens](#js/ts.referencesCodeLens.enabled) on all functions in JavaScript and TypeScript files.
configuration.implementationsCodeLens.en: Enable/disable implementations CodeLens in TypeScript files. This CodeLens shows the implementers of TypeScript interfaces.
Enable/disable inlay hints for parameter names:
```typescript

parseInt(/* str: */ '123', /* radix: */ 8)
 
```
inlayHints.parameterNames.literals: Enable parameter name hints only for literal arguments.
inlayHints.parameterNames.all: Enable parameter name hints for literal and non-literal arguments.
Suppress parameter name hints on arguments whose text is identical to the parameter name.
Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit parameter types:
```typescript

el.addEventListener('click', e /* :MouseEvent */ => ...)
 
```
configuration.inlayHints.variableTypes.e:
Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit variable types:
```typescript

const foo /* :number */ = Date.now();
 
```
configuration.inlayHints.variableTypes.s: Suppress type hints on variables whose name is identical to the type name.
